These units provided housing for a total of 13,483 employees of the Company and their dependents. During FY 1976, consolidation of U.S. and Latin American citizen housing was initiated and served to eliminate the <u>de facto</u> separation of the two groups and the appearance of discriminatory practices in housing. The Community Services Division of the Company which operates this housing as well as maintaining grounds and other buildings in the Zone employed a staff of 723 in FY 1975.
4. Employment
At the end of fiscal year 1976 the total Isthmian force of the Company/Government was 13,721 compared to 14,898 in fiscal year 1975. Of the total in 1976, 13,136 were full time and 584 were part time. In addition, there were 36 military personnel, including the Governor and Lieutenant Governor, assigned to the Company/Government on the Isthmus. Eighty-nine persons, all U.S. citizens, were employed by the Company in New Orleans and Washington, D.C.
Approximately 73 percent of the total Isthmian force is comprised of non-U.S. citizens (predominantly Panamanian), and the remaining 27 percent U.S. citizens. Rates of pay are established on a Canal Zone wage base for occupational categories which can be filled by recruitment on the Isthmus, and on a U.S. wage base for those positions which would normally be filled by recruitment from the United States.
